title: Gluten-Free Overnight Yeasted Waffles
description: In this recipe, gluten-free waffles with a delicate yeast flavor get a crispy and crunchy outside, but are melt-in-your-mouth soft on the inside. Start them the night before.

steps.text: Approximately 9 hours or the night before making waffles, stir together warm water, honey, and yeast in a small bowl until well combined. Let sit until bubbly, 5 to 10 minutes.

Combine milk and olive oil in a large bowl. Add 1 1/2 cups gluten-free flour, 1/4 cup at a time, mixing well between each addition, to create a thick but pourable batter. Add more flour if batter is too thin, 1/8 cup at a time.

Stir yeast mixture into batter until just combined. Cover the bowl with a lid or plastic wrap and leave on the kitchen counter for 8 hours to overnight; batter will double or even triple in volume, so be sure the bowl is large enough.
When you are ready to make waffles, mix beaten egg and salt into batter in the bowl until incorporated.
Preheat a waffle iron according to manufacturer's instructions.
Cook about 1/4 cup batter in the preheated waffle iron until waffle is golden brown and the iron stops steaming, about 5 minutes. Repeat with remaining batter.
